title: Sanlorenzo SL86
highlights: White leather and walnut interior upgrades
description:
This 2019 Sanlorenzo SL86 features the yard's asymmetric layout, opening the main deck to the sea on one side. She welcomes eight guests in four cabins and cruises at 27 knots on twin MTU 12V 2000 M96L engines.

Upgraded options include zero-speed electric stabilisers, a second 25 kW generator, a diamond audio-video package and white leather and walnut interior finishes. Contact Yacht Research for location and viewing.
